d:
Gokuldham Society celebrates Ganesh Utsav with a modern fancy dress competition highlighting digital life and social habits. Popatlal performs as a modern couch potato ("energy-saving mode"), humorously demonstrating how apps, delivery services, work-from-home, and voice assistants run everyday life without anyone lifting a finger.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
